trustedProxies.title: Trusted proxies
trustedProxies.label: Reverse proxies in front of this instance
trustedProxies.help: One address or network per line (127.0.0.1, 172.18.0.0/16, fd00::/8). Only list the reverse proxy you put in front of Meshloom (nginx, Caddy, Traefik, cloudflared). From these addresses only, Meshloom believes X-Forwarded-For (the visitor's address, used for sign-in delays, the audit log and sessions) and X-Forwarded-Proto (https: secure cookie). A listed address can claim to be anyone, so never list a network your visitors come from.
trustedProxies.none: Empty: no proxy is trusted. Forwarded headers are ignored and the visitor's address is the one of the connection.
trustedProxies.invalid: Not an IP address or network (an address, or address/prefix; not /0): {{entries}}
trustedProxies.saveFailed: Could not save the trusted proxies

errors.auth_trusted_proxies_invalid: Not an IP address or network, or more than 32 trusted proxies
